newsitem.title: UK: London sugar freight sees some new enquiry.
newsitem.headline: London sugar freight sees some new enquiry.

text.p: Fresh inquiry was reported from South American and southern Africa on Monday in the London sugar freight market.
E D and F Man had 12,600 bulk Maceio/Black Sea with options 23/30 June and the S Africa Sugar Association 24,000 bulk Durban/Japan early July

Fixtures included Genoc with 14,000 bagged Santos/Nigeria prompt, 14,000 bagged E C Mexico/Baltic, Black Sea, Med, Red Sea, Arabian Gulf and Indian sub-continent, 12/12,500 bulk Thailand/Vladivostock 17/20 June.

Dreyfus was reported to have fixed 30,000 bulk Philippines/USWC 15/25 June, 14,000 bulk Thailand/S Korea 20/25 June approx $17.00, 7,000 bulk Thailand/Prai June, and Man 7,630 bagged Santander + Gijon/Dubai for June.
